issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Hemory
products.tagline: Keep listening. Searchable memory for your AI agents.
products.summaryZh: 持续聆听。为你的AI代理提供可搜索的记忆。
products.descriptionZh: Hemory 源自 Hear + Memory。它不是会议转录：Hemory 在你已有的手机或 Apple Watch 上聆听，把每段对话留存为记忆。你的一天会自动切分为带说话人标签的时刻，随后沉淀为私密、可搜索的记忆。通过 MCP 将它连接到 Claude、Codex、Cursor 或任何 agent，你的 AI 终于拥有真实上下文，可以回溯你听到的内容并在此基础上继续构建。
products.description: Hemory comes from Hear + Memory. It's not meeting transcription: Hemory listens on the phone or Apple Watch you already own, and keeps every conversation as memory. Your day is auto-split into moments with speaker labels, then settles into a private, searchable memory. Connect it to Claude, Codex, Cursor, or any agent over MCP, and your AI finally has real context to revisit what you heard and build on it.

products.name: Eclatira
products.tagline: Conversational Video Agent That Plugs Into Any Stack
products.summaryZh: 可接入任何技术栈的对话式视频代理
products.descriptionZh: 将实时对话视频AI接入任何应用。Eclatira为开发者提供原生语音到语音、实时视觉，以及跨自定义API、MCP和3000多个应用的全栈执行能力。快速交付自主多模态视频代理。
products.description: Plug real-time conversational video AI into any application. Eclatira gives developers native voice-to-voice, live vision, and full-stack execution across custom APIs, MCPs, and 3,000+ apps. Ship autonomous multimodal video agents fast.

products.name: Chit
products.tagline: A printed receipt of your day in Claude Code
products.summaryZh: 你在 Claude Code 中一天的打印收据
products.descriptionZh: Chit 读取你磁盘上已有的 Claude Code 记录，把当天的内容打印成一张收据，按项目分组，可直接粘贴到站会。一个 777 KB 的 Mac 应用。无需 Hammerspoon，无需 Python，无需账号，二进制文件中完全没有网络代码。
products.description: Chit reads the Claude Code transcripts already on your disk and prints the day back as a receipt, grouped by project and ready to paste into a standup. A 777 KB Mac app. No Hammerspoon, no Python, no account, and no network code in the binary at all.

products.name: Paragraph Notes
products.tagline: A private Markdown notes app for Mac
products.summaryZh: 一款适用于 Mac 的私密 Markdown 笔记应用
products.descriptionZh: Paragraph Notes 是一款注重隐私的 Mac Markdown 笔记应用。在简洁、无干扰的纯文本编辑器中书写。Paragraph Notes 不收集任何数据，也从不连接互联网。笔记以开放、可移植的格式存储在本地。免费使用 Paragraph Notes 最多可创建 20 条笔记。通过一次性应用内购买升级至 Pro，即可获得无限笔记。
products.description: Paragraph Notes is a privacy-focused Markdown notes app for Mac. Write in a simple, distraction-free plain text editor. Paragraph Notes collects no data and never connects to the internet. Notes are stored locally in an open, portable format. Use Paragraph Notes free for up to 20 notes. Upgrade to Pro with a one-time in-app purchase for unlimited notes.

products.name: GoodSocials
products.tagline: AI social media manager for LinkedIn. Only authentic content
products.summaryZh: LinkedIn 的 AI 社交媒体经理。只发布真实内容
products.descriptionZh: 面向LinkedIn的AI社交媒体经理。撰写高质量内容，你在看板中审批，它负责排期，让你保持规律发布，接近每日更新。
products.description: AI social media manager for LinkedIn. Writes high quality content, you approve it in a kanban board, it schedules so you post regularly, close to daily.

products.name: Fewer
products.tagline: The launcher that counts how often you pick up your phone
products.summaryZh: 记录你拿起手机次数的启动器
products.descriptionZh: 一款围绕“拿起”而非屏幕使用时间打造的 Android 启动器。安静的主屏显示今日任务、你看手机的次数（以及其中多少次毫无目的），还有你真正会用的六个工具。时间黑洞会被暂停。无服务器、无账号、无广告。
products.description: An Android launcher built around pickups, not screen time. A quiet home screen shows today's task, how many times you've looked at your phone (and how many for nothing) and the six tools you actually use. Time sinks get a pause. No server, no account, no ads.

products.name: Psst
products.tagline: A shared shopping list that remembers what things cost
products.summaryZh: 一个共享购物清单，能记住每样东西的价格
products.descriptionZh: Psst 是一个共享购物清单。它的实用之处在于会记住你付了多少钱。拍一张收据，条目就会以结构化形式呈现，每一条都显示其来源行的裁剪图，以及该商品上次的价格和购买地点。大部分工作都花在了不确定时不妄下结论上。不同单位的两个价格绝不会被拿来比较，而且比较的是单价，不是行总计：买 2kg 而不是 1kg 不算涨价。支持 iOS 和 Android。
products.description: Psst is a shared shopping list. The useful part is that it remembers what you paid. Photograph a receipt and the lines come back structured, each one showing a crop of the row it came from and what that item cost last time, and where. Most of the work went into not saying so when it isn't sure. Two prices in different units are never compared, and comparison is on unit price, not the line total: buying 2kg instead of 1kg is not a price rise. iOS and Android.

products.name: Kleanly
products.tagline: One tap in the notch locks your keyboard and trackpad
products.summaryZh: 轻点凹口即可锁定键盘和触控板
products.descriptionZh: Kleanly 就住在你的 MacBook 刘海里。轻点一下，键盘和触控板即刻锁定，你可以放心擦拭整机，视频照常播放。孩子看动画时乱拍键盘，也不会输入任何内容。完成后双击触控板即可解锁。自首次发布以来的新增功能：刘海控制、应用内更新、自行将许可证迁移到新 Mac，以及为无刘海显示屏提供的小标签页。
products.description: Kleanly lives in your MacBook's notch. Tap it once and your keyboard and trackpad are locked, so you can wipe everything down while your video keeps playing. Kids can slap the keys during a cartoon and nothing gets typed. Double tap the trackpad when you're done. New since our first launch: the notch control, in-app updates, moving your license to a new Mac yourself, and a small tab on displays without a notch.

products.name: Lisen
products.tagline: Free Read Aloud with Cartesia Voices
products.summaryZh: 免费使用Cartesia语音朗读
products.descriptionZh: 使用 Cartesia 语音免费朗读任意文章。无需在 Cartesia 套餐之外额外订阅。
products.description: Free read aloud for any article with your Cartesia voices. No subscription on top of your Cartesia plan.

products.name: SOUND
products.tagline: Give every Mac app its own EQ, volume, and speaker.
products.summaryZh: 让每个Mac应用拥有独立的均衡器、音量和扬声器。
products.descriptionZh: macOS 只有一个音量滑块，没有均衡器。SOUND 让每个正在播放的应用都拥有自己的 8 段均衡器、独立音量和输出设备——直接从菜单栏操作。无需虚拟音频驱动或账户；音频始终留在你的 Mac 上。免费提供，支持 10 种语言。
products.description: macOS has one volume slider and no equalizer. SOUND gives every playing app its own 8-band EQ, independent volume, and output device—right from the menu bar. No virtual audio driver or account; audio stays on your Mac. Free and available in 10 languages.

products.name: VehicleERP
products.tagline: VehicleERP - Used Car Management Software
products.summaryZh: VehicleERP - 二手车管理软件
products.descriptionZh: VehicleERP 是专为从事车辆买卖与管理的经销商打造的二手车管理软件。在一个平台上追踪库存、采购、费用、销售、付款、GST 账单、合作伙伴、员工、分支机构及利润。AI 可协助为车辆定价、扫描文件、发现滞销库存与错误、预测业绩，并利用你的业务数据回答问题。
products.description: VehicleERP is used car management software built for dealers who buy, sell, and manage vehicles. Track inventory, purchases, expenses, sales, payments, GST bills, partners, staff, branches, and profit on one platform. AI helps price vehicles, scan documents, spot ageing stock and mistakes, forecast performance, and answer questions using your business data.

products.name: What to Order
products.tagline: Find food you’ll love on any restaurant menu
products.summaryZh: 在任何餐厅菜单上找到你喜爱的美食
products.descriptionZh: 你有没有在The Cheesecake Factory坐下，接过菜单？331道菜。你翻来翻去，毫无头绪，最后还是点了和上次一样的东西。What to Order反其道而行。告诉它你想吃什么口味，它会替你查看菜单上的每道菜。“辣”可以。“辣味素食”也行。点“两人份感恩节晚餐”，你会得到完整的一单，包括南瓜芝士蛋糕。目前我们覆盖了7家美国连锁餐厅。在别处吃？拍张菜单照片就行。免费。
products.description: Ever sat down at The Cheesecake Factory and been handed the menu? 331 items. You flip through it, get nowhere, and order the same thing as last time. What to Order works the other way around. Tell it what you’re in the mood for and it checks every dish on the menu for you. “Spicy” works. “Spicy vegetarian” too. Ask for “Thanksgiving dinner for 2” and you get a whole order, pumpkin cheesecake included. We have 7 US chains so far. Eating somewhere else? Snap a photo of the menu. It’s free.

products.name: ZenMode OS · Android Launcher
products.tagline: Good phone habits! paid in gold, all with your friends.
products.summaryZh: 良好的手机使用习惯！以黄金为代价，与朋友共享。
products.descriptionZh: ZenMode OS 是一款开源 Android 启动器，让有意识的选择比冲动的选择更容易。一个 Zen Score、真正的问责机制，以及以黄金而非多巴胺形式落地的奖励。
products.description: ZenMode OS is an open source Android launcher that makes the intentional choice easier than the impulsive one. One Zen Score, real accountability, and rewards that land in gold instead of dopamine.

products.name: Inqueria: Interviews that Hold Up
products.tagline: AI that interviews your users like a trained researcher
products.summaryZh: 像训练有素的研究员一样访谈用户的AI
products.descriptionZh: Inqueria 运行由 AI 主持的访谈，能像训练有素的研究员那样根据每个回答灵活调整。它在任何模型接触访谈记录之前，先在内部对个人身份信息进行脱敏，然后将每段对话转化为主题，并附上支撑这些主题的准确引述。它会对照每一份访谈记录核查每个主题，并向你展示持不同意见的参与者。一夜之间完成 50 场访谈，省去安排五场访谈所需的一个月时间。
products.description: Inqueria runs AI-moderated interviews that adapt to every answer, the way a trained researcher would. It redacts PII in-house before any model sees a transcript, then turns every conversation into themes with the exact quotes behind them. It checks each theme against every transcript and shows you the participants who disagree. Run 50 interviews overnight. Skip the month it takes to schedule five.

products.name: Big Weather
products.tagline: Menu Bar Forecast, now with AI Insights
products.summaryZh: 菜单栏天气预报，现支持AI洞察
products.descriptionZh: Big Weather 将天气放进你的 Mac 菜单栏：未来几天以一条可拖动的曲线呈现，紫外线逐小时显示，并可通过 Premium 获得 AI 洞察和官方天气预警。
products.description: Big Weather puts the weather in your Mac's menu bar: the days ahead as one curve you can scrub through, UV hour by hour, and with Premium, AI insights and official weather warnings.

products.name: Brainlist Calendar
products.tagline: every notes entry shows up in your list AND your calendar
products.summaryZh: 每条笔记都会同时出现在你的列表和日历中
products.descriptionZh: 它由一位ADHD人士为希望完成各项任务和活动的人打造。它帮助你规划一天，列表视图将所有事件和任务呈现在同一条时间线上，月历视图则自动同步，此外还有艾森豪威尔重要/紧急矩阵，以及在你无法决定从何开始时使用的转盘选择器。通过“大脑倾倒”，你可以快速输入或口述一个想法，之后再回头处理，而这条笔记不会被永远埋没。
products.description: It's made from someone with ADHD for people who want to get tasks and events done. It helps you plan your day, with a list view that shows all events and tasks in one timeline AND a monthly calendar view that syncs automatically, as well as an Eisenhower importance/urgency Matrix and a spin-the-wheel picker for when you can't decide what to start with. With Brain Dump you quickly capture type or dictate a thought and then you can get back to it later without the note being buried away forever.

products.name: ButterShare
products.tagline: Share Anything, to Anyone. No File Limits
products.summaryZh: 分享一切，给任何人。无文件限制
products.descriptionZh: ButterShare 让你无需云存储或注册，即可在设备间直接分享任意大小的文件。只需简单的 3 步流程，你就能通过 6 位房间代码即时发送文件。该服务采用端到端加密保障隐私，非常适合安全地分享大文件。
products.description: ButterShare allows you to share files of any size directly between devices without the need for cloud storage or sign-ups. With a simple 3-step process, you can send files instantly using a 6-character room code. The service ensures privacy with end-to-end encryption, making it ideal for sharing large files securely.

products.name: Bump
products.tagline: Your AI collections team for email and WhatsApp
products.summaryZh: 你的AI催收团队，负责电子邮件和WhatsApp
products.descriptionZh: Bump 是一款面向应收账款的 AI 催收引擎。它会持续跟进每一张逾期发票直至回款——通过电子邮件和 WhatsApp 进行催收、读取回复、跟踪承诺与还款计划，并自行升级处理——让回款流程自动运转。如同增加了一支催收团队，却无需实际招聘。
products.description: Bump is an AI collections engine for accounts receivable. It works every overdue invoice to paid — chasing across email and WhatsApp, reading replies, tracking promises and payment plans, and escalating on its own — so getting paid runs itself. Like adding a collections team, without hiring one.

products.name: Finantly
products.tagline: All your finances in one place — budgets and investments.
products.summaryZh: 你的所有财务信息集中一处——预算与投资。
products.descriptionZh: Finantly将你的账户、预算、投资和债务汇聚成清晰统一的视图。导入银行CSV文件，自动分类会学习你的选择；实时追踪多币种净资产；基于你的数据——而非猜测——使用FIRE、购车、房地产和贷款计算器进行规划。完全掌控你的资金，无需电子表格。
products.description: Finantly brings your accounts, budgets, investments and debts into one clear view. Import bank CSV files with auto-categories that learn your choices, track net worth in real time across currencies, and plan with FIRE, car, real estate and loan calculators built on your data — not guesswork. Full control over your money, no spreadsheets required.

products.name: MakerMap
products.tagline: A living map of makers and what they’re building
products.summaryZh: 创客及其所造之物的动态地图
products.descriptionZh: MakerMap 是一张创客世界的动态地图。探索 4,000 多位创客与产品，按细分领域、地点、兴趣或人们正在打造的事物进行搜索，浏览实时个人资料，找到值得结识的人。添加你自己，成为这张地图的一部分。
products.description: MakerMap is a living map of the maker world. Discover 4,000+ makers and products, search by niche, location, interests or what people are building, explore live profiles, and find people worth meeting. Add yourself and become part of the map.
